description: OHLCV candles for one Hyperliquid perp or spot symbol, from Hyperliquid's public info API ({"type":"candleSnapshot"}). Each candle: open/high/low/close/volume (base units), trade count, and the interval's start/end timestamps. Pass `lookback_hours` for a window ending now (default 24h), or an explicit `start_time`/`end_time` (ISO date/datetime or unix seconds/milliseconds) for a specific historical window — Hyperliquid retains candle history well beyond 24h. `interval` accepts Hyperliquid's own granularities: 1m, 3m, 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 2h, 4h, 8h, 12h, 1d, 3d, 1w, 1M.

coin.description: Perp symbol (e.g. "BTC") or spot pair id/name (e.g. "@0" or "PURR/USDC").

end_time.description: Window END — same formats as start_time. Defaults to now.

lookback_hours.description: Window length ending now, in hours (default 24). Ignored when start_time is given.

start_time.description: Window START — ISO date/datetime or unix seconds/milliseconds. Use with end_time for a window that does not end now.

name: hyperliquid_candles
title: Hyperliquid Candles
